package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type ApplyPracticeEvidence struct {
	Evidence repository.PracticeEvidence
}

func (useCase ApplyPracticeEvidence) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, idempotencyKey string, input domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle) (domain.PracticeEvidenceReceipt, error) {
	if useCase.Evidence == nil {
		return domain.PracticeEvidenceReceipt{}, errors.New("learning evidence repository is required")
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizePracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle(studentID, idempotencyKey, input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeEvidenceReceipt{}, err
	}
	accepted, err := useCase.Evidence.ApplyPracticeEvidence(ctx, normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PracticeEvidenceReceipt{}, err
	}
	return domain.PracticeEvidenceReceipt{
		Schema:        domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptSchemaV1,
		EvidenceID:    normalized.EvidenceID,
		Accepted:      accepted,
		PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion,
	}, nil
}
